items.en: That product sold like crazy the moment it was put on the shelf.
items.hi: वह सामान शेल्फ़ पर रखते ही, बिजली की तरह बिक जाता था।
items.gu: તે સામાન શેલ્ફ પર મૂકતાં જ, વીજળીની જેમ વેચાઈ જતો હતો.

opts.en: while also (wrong — no two ongoing roles here)

items.why: Products selling out the instant they're shelved (a repeated, immediate cause-effect) is exactly Point 1's そばから.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 6 · 散歩がてら

items.q: （ ）店を続ける気はないです。
items.qr: (___) mise o tsuzukeru ki wa nai desu.
items.en: I have no intention of continuing to run the store even at the cost of taking a loss.
items.hi: नुक़सान उठाकर भी दुकान चलाने का कोई इरादा नहीं है।
items.gu: નુકસાન વેઠીને પણ દુકાન ચલાવવાનો કોઈ ઇરાદો નથી.

opts.en: although it's a loss (wrong — doesn't match the "willing to go this far" sense)
even if it's a loss (wrong register/fit for this structure)
(wrong — までも needs the て-form, not する directly)
even to the point of taking a loss

items.why: Week 3 Day 1's てまでも needs the て-form (して) before までも, describing the drastic length (a financial loss) one is unwilling to go to.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 普段着はシンプルで（ ）。
items.qr: Fudangi wa shinpuru de (___).
items.en: For everyday clothes, simple and durable is best.
items.hi: रोज़मर्रा के कपड़े सादे और मज़बूत हों तो सबसे अच्छा है।
items.gu: રોજિંદા કપડાં સાદા અને મજબૂત હોય તો સૌથી સારું છે.

opts.en: (wrong — 限りだ is for emotional adjectives, not "durable")
not limited to being durable (wrong sense entirely)
(wrong — this isn't a "not unique to X" claim)

items.why: Week 3 Day 2's に限る recommends durability as simply the best quality for everyday clothes.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 病気（ ）、いつまでも仕事を休んではいられない。
items.qr: Byouki (___), itsu made mo shigoto o yasunde wa irarenai.
items.en: Even though I'm sick, I can't keep taking time off work forever.
items.hi: बीमार होने के बावजूद, हमेशा के लिए काम से छुट्टी नहीं ले सकता/सकती।
items.gu: બીમાર હોવા છતાં, હંમેશા માટે કામમાંથી રજા લઈ ન શકાય.

opts.en: needless to say (wrong — doesn't fit as a concession)
thought that... (wrong — no reversed expectation here)

items.why: Week 3 Day 3's とはいえ concedes being sick while still asserting the obligation to work holds.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: その商品がヒットしたの（ ）、次々と類似品が発売された。
items.qr: Sono shouhin ga hitto shita no (___), tsugitsugi to ruijihin ga hatsubai sareta.
items.en: Starting with that product's hit, similar products were released one after another.
items.hi: उस उत्पाद के हिट होने के बाद, एक के बाद एक जैसे उत्पाद बाज़ार में आ गए।
items.gu: તે પ્રોડક્ટ હિટ થયા પછી, એક પછી એક એવી પ્રોડક્ટ બજારમાં આવી ગઈ.

opts.en: once ~, inevitably (wrong — no unstoppable habit here)
the moment (wrong — this needs a plain verb form, not a noun-marked event)

items.why: A hit product triggering a growing series of imitators is exactly Week 3 Day 4's を皮切りに.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 近くまで来ましたので、ご挨拶（ ）お伺いしました。
items.qr: Chikaku made kimashita node, go-aisatsu (___) oukagai shimashita.
items.en: Since I was nearby, I came to visit, combined with paying my respects.
items.hi: पास ही आया/आई था/थी, तो अभिवादन के साथ आपसे मिलने आया/आई।
items.gu: નજીકમાં જ આવ્યો/આવી હતો/હતી, તો અભિવાદનની સાથે તમને મળવા આવ્યો/આવી.

opts.en: while also (wrong — no two ongoing life-roles)
while (wrong — too casual/simultaneous for this greeting)

items.why: Week 3 Day 6's かたがた is the standard formal-visit phrase combining a greeting with the act of dropping by.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 明日（ ）、退職いたします。
items.qr: Ashita (___), taishoku itashimasu.
items.en: As of tomorrow, I will retire.
items.hi: कल से, मैं इस्तीफ़ा दे रहा/रही हूँ।
items.gu: આવતીકાલથી, હું રાજીનામું આપી રહ્યો/રહી છું.

opts.en: for the entire duration of (wrong — this is a single cutoff point, not a duration)

items.why: Week 3 Day 4's をもって② formally marks tomorrow as the cutoff date for retirement — the same function as を限りに.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: デパートが開店する（ ）、主婦たちが特売場に押し寄せた。
items.qr: Depaato ga kaiten suru (___), shufutachi ga tokubaijou ni oshiyoseta.
items.en: No sooner had the department store opened than housewives rushed to the sale floor.
items.hi: डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर खुलते ही, गृहणियाँ सेल वाले हिस्से की ओर दौड़ पड़ीं।
items.gu: ડિપાર્ટમેન્ટ સ્ટોર ખુલતાં જ, ગૃહિણીઓ સેલ વિભાગ તરફ દોડી ગઈ.

opts.en: immediately undone (wrong — opening isn't "undone," just followed by a rush)

items.why: A quick, almost simultaneous reaction (housewives rushing in) to a trigger (the store opening) is Week 3 Day 5's が早いか.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: （ ）と思っていたことだったが、記録しておいてよかった。
items.qr: (___) to omotte ita koto datta ga, kiroku shite oite yokatta.
items.en: I had thought there was no need to even write it down, but it was good that I recorded it.
items.hi: लगा था कि लिखने की ज़रूरत भी नहीं, लेकिन लिख लिया वह अच्छा हुआ।
items.gu: લાગ્યું હતું કે લખવાની જરૂર પણ નથી, પણ લખી લીધું તે સારું થયું.

opts.en: (wrong — downplays something already done, not a future need)

items.why: Week 3 Day 1's までもない dismisses writing as unnecessary — until the outcome (glad it was recorded) proved that assumption wrong.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 語彙を勉強しているが、覚えたと思った（ ）忘れてしまう。
items.qr: Goi o benkyou shite iru ga, oboeta to omotta (___) wasurete shimau.
items.en: I'm studying vocabulary, but no sooner do I think I've memorized it than I forget it.
items.hi: शब्दावली पढ़ रहा/रही हूँ, लेकिन याद हुआ लगते ही भूल जाता/जाती हूँ।
items.gu: શબ્દભંડોળ ભણી રહ્યો/રહી છું, પણ યાદ થયું લાગે કે તરત ભૂલી જાઉં છું.

opts.en: combined with (wrong — not a formal visit)
while also (wrong — not two ongoing roles)
while doing (wrong — not a two-purpose trip)

items.why: Memorization being instantly undone by forgetting is exactly Week 3 Day 6's そばから.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: この3週間（ ）、ろくに寝ていない。
items.qr: Kono san-shuukan (___), roku ni nete inai.
items.en: For these entire three weeks, I haven't slept properly.
items.hi: इन तीन हफ़्तों में, ठीक से सोया/सोई ही नहीं।
items.gu: આ ત્રણ અઠવાડિયામાં, બરાબર ઊંઘ્યો/ઊંઘી જ નથી.

opts.en: even ~ (wrong — a concession, not a duration marker)

items.why: An unbroken continuous state (poor sleep) across a named period is Week 3 Day 4's というもの.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: とにかくやってみよう。できなければ、あきらめる（ ）。
items.qr: Tonikaku yatte miyou. Dekinakereba, akirameru (___).
items.en: Anyway, let's try it. If it doesn't work, that just means giving up, nothing more.
items.hi: बहरहाल, कोशिश करते हैं। अगर न हो पाए, तो बस छोड़ देना ही काफ़ी है।
items.gu: ગમે તે થાય, પ્રયત્ન કરીએ. જો ન થાય, તો બસ છોડી દેવું જ પૂરતું છે.

opts.en: no need to even (wrong — giving up isn't being dismissed as unnecessary)
that's all there is to it

items.why: Week 3 Day 1's まで（のこと）だ downplays giving up as simply the natural, unremarkable consequence if the attempt fails.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 彼が美人で若いお嫁さんをもらったとは、うらやましい（ ）。
items.qr: Kare ga bijin de wakai oyomesan o moratta towa, urayamashii (___).
items.en: The fact that he got a beautiful young wife is envious in the extreme.
items.hi: उसे इतनी सुंदर और जवान पत्नी मिली, यह बेहद ईर्ष्या की बात है।
items.gu: તેને આટલી સુંદર અને યુવાન પત્ની મળી, આ ખૂબ જ ઈર્ષ્યાની વાત છે.

opts.en: (wrong — negates the intensity, opposite of intended meaning)
is the best (wrong — not a recommendation)

items.why: Week 3 Day 2's 限りだ intensifies envy to its peak, matching とは's exclamatory opening.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 遊びがてら（ ）。
items.qr: Asobi gatera (___).
items.en: Please do come by whenever you're out and about.
items.hi: घूमते-फिरते ज़रूर आ जाइए।
items.gu: ફરતાં ફરતાં જરૂર આવજો.

opts.en: please study well (wrong tone — doesn't match a casual "drop by" invitation)

opts.t: 看護師の勉強をしています
opts.r: kangoshi no benkyou o shite imasu

opts.t: ぜひいらっしゃってください

opts.en: (unrelated — this would need かたがた, not がてら)

items.why: 遊びがてら sets up a casual invitation (matching the book's own example, 遊びがてらお立ち寄りください) — only option 3 continues naturally as an invitation to visit.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 彼女は子どもを育てるかたわら、（ ）。
items.qr: Kanojo wa kodomo o sodateru katawara, (___).
items.en: While raising her children, she also runs a cooking class at home.
items.hi: बच्चों को पालने के साथ-साथ, वह घर पर खाना पकाने की कक्षा भी चलाती है।
items.gu: બાળકોને ઉછેરવાની સાથે સાથે, તે ઘરે રસોઈનો ક્લાસ પણ ચલાવે છે.

opts.t: 時間が足りなくて悩んでいる
opts.en: (a complaint, not a second ongoing role)

opts.t: 家で料理教室も開いている
opts.r: ie de ryouri kyoushitsu mo hiraite iru
opts.en: also runs a cooking class at home

opts.t: 家事が得意で何をするのも早い
opts.r: kaji ga tokui de nani o suru no mo hayai
opts.en: (a personality trait, not a second role)

opts.t: 将来は教師の資格を生かしたいそうだ
opts.r: shourai wa kyoushi no shikaku o ikashitai sou da
opts.en: (a future hope, not a current ongoing activity)

items.why: かたわら needs a genuinely separate ongoing secondary activity, matching the pattern's own example structure (running a shop alongside farming) — only option 2 names a real second occupation happening now.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 今日の試合に負けたといえども、（ ）。
items.qr: Kyou no shiai ni maketa to ie domo, (___).
items.en: Even though we lost today's match, there was almost no gap in strength between us and the other team.
items.hi: आज का मैच हारने के बावजूद, विरोधी टीम से ताक़त का फ़र्क़ लगभग नहीं था।
items.gu: આજની મેચ હાર્યા હોવા છતાં, વિરોધી ટીમ સાથે તાકાતનો ફરક લગભગ નહોતો.

opts.t: 勝つわけがないと思っていた
opts.r: katsu wake ga nai to omotte ita
opts.en: (contradicts といえども's concessive redeeming point)

opts.t: 勝てなかったのは仕方がなかった
opts.r: katenakatta no wa shikata ga nakatta
opts.en: (plausible, but doesn't redeem/qualify the loss as strongly)

opts.t: 相手チームとの力の差はほとんどなかった
opts.r: aite chiimu to no chikara no sa wa hotondo nakatta
opts.en: the gap in strength was almost nonexistent

opts.t: 相手チームほどの実力はなかった
opts.r: aite chiimu hodo no jitsuryoku wa nakatta
opts.en: (contradicts the redeeming point — admits being weaker)

items.why: といえども concedes the loss while still asserting something that softens/redeems it — option 3 asserts the teams were nearly evenly matched despite the loss, the classic "even though X, still Y holds" shape.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: ダイエットを成功させるのが難しいと感じているのは、私に（ ）だろう。
items.why: Week 3 Day 2's に限ったことではない — the difficulty isn't unique to the writer.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 甘いおやつも今日（ ）やめようと思うのだが…
items.why: Week 3 Day 2's を限りに marks today as the intended cutoff point for eating sweets.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 健康を害する恐れもあるということは（ ）。
items.why: Week 3 Day 1's 言うまでもない — the health risk is so obvious it needs no stating.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 理想の体重になった（ ）、リバウンドすることもよくあるからだ。

opts.en: the instant (plausible, but や否や flows more naturally into a habitual からだ clause)
thought that... (wrong — no stated expectation being reversed)

items.why: Week 3 Day 5's や否や explains why extreme diets are bad: reaching the ideal weight is almost immediately followed by rebounding.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 結局（ ）、適度な運動をしてカロリーを消費したり、筋肉をつけることが大切だ。

opts.t: 毎日とはいかないまでも

opts.en: even every day (wrong — doesn't lower a bar, contradicts context)
for the entire duration of every day (wrong — redundant/nonsensical here)

items.why: Week 3 Day 1's ないまでも (here as the natural collocation とはいかないまでも) concedes that daily exercise may not be realistic, while still recommending moderate exercise as the achievable minimum.
items.unit: Week 3 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 何を買う（ ）、デパートの中をぶらぶらしていたら、友人に会った。
items.qr: Nani o kau (___), depaato no naka o burabura shite itara, yuujin ni atta.
items.en: I was wandering around the department store without any particular thing to buy in mind, and I ran into a friend.
items.hi: बिना कुछ ख़ास ख़रीदने के इरादे के डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर में घूम रहा था, तभी एक दोस्त से मुलाक़ात हो गई।
items.gu: કંઈ ખાસ ખરીદવાના ઇરાદા વગર ડિપાર્ટમેન્ટ સ્ટોરમાં ફરી રહ્યો હતો, ત્યારે એક મિત્રને મળી ગયો.

opts.en: without doing (wrong — needs a condition, not aimless browsing)

items.why: Wandering aimlessly with no clear shopping purpose is Point 3's ともなく; ことなしに states a strict precondition, which doesn't fit "browsing without purpose."
items.unit: Week 4 Day 1 · やればできるものを

items.q: 黙っていればいい（ ）、つい余計なことを言ってしまった。
items.qr: Damatte ireba ii (___), tsui yokei na koto o itte shimatta.
items.en: If only I'd stayed quiet, but I ended up saying something unnecessary.
items.hi: चुप रह जाता तो अच्छा था, लेकिन ग़लती से कुछ ज़्यादा बोल दिया।
items.gu: મૌન રહ્યો હોત તો સારું હતું, પણ ભૂલથી કંઈક વધારે બોલી ગયો.
items.why: Regretting not staying silent is exactly Point 4's ものを.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 1 · やればできるものを

items.q: 健康な体（ ）どんなにお金があっても幸せとは言えない。
items.qr: Kenkou na karada (___) donna ni okane ga atte mo shiawase towa ienai.
items.en: Without a healthy body, no matter how much money you have, you can't call yourself happy.
items.hi: स्वस्थ शरीर के बिना, चाहे कितना भी पैसा हो, ख़ुशी नहीं कही जा सकती।
items.gu: તંદુરસ્ત શરીર વગર, ભલે ગમે તેટલા પૈસા હોય, ખુશી ન કહી શકાય.
items.why: Point 1's なくして takes the optional は for extra emphasis; なくしてに isn't a valid grammatical form.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 1 · やればできるものを

items.q: この小説は涙（ ）読むことができない。
items.qr: Kono shousetsu wa namida (___) yomu koto ga dekinai.
items.en: I cannot read this novel without crying.
items.hi: यह उपन्यास बिना आँसू बहाए पढ़ा नहीं जा सकता।
items.gu: આ નવલકથા આંસુ વગર વાંચી શકાય નહીં.
items.why: Point 2's なしに is the standard "without ~" marker for 涙 (tears); なくで isn't a recognized grammatical form.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 1 · やればできるものを

items.q: 駅を降りたら、どこから（ ）おいしそうないい匂いがしてきた。
items.qr: Eki o oritara, doko kara (___) oishisou na ii nioi ga shite kita.
items.en: When I got off at the station, a delicious smell started coming from who-knows-where.
items.hi: स्टेशन पर उतरते ही, न जाने कहाँ से एक स्वादिष्ट-सी ख़ुशबू आने लगी।
items.gu: સ્ટેશન પર ઉતરતાં જ, ક્યાંકથી એક સ્વાદિષ્ટ સુગંધ આવવા લાગી.

opts.en: without (wrong — this describes a source, not a missing precondition)

items.why: どこからともなく ("from an unspecified/unknown source") is the fixed question-word extension of Point 3's ともなく.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 1 · やればできるものを

items.q: 彼はとてもいい人だ。でも結婚（ ）、ちょっと頼りない気がする。
items.qr: Kare wa totemo ii hito da. Demo kekkon (___), chotto tayorinai ki ga suru.
items.en: He's a very nice person. But when it comes to marriage, I feel he's a bit unreliable.
items.hi: वह बहुत अच्छा इंसान है। लेकिन शादी की बात आते ही, थोड़ा भरोसे लायक़ नहीं लगता।
items.gu: તે ખૂબ સારો વ્યક્તિ છે. પણ લગ્નની વાત આવે ત્યારે, થોડો ભરોસાપાત્ર નથી લાગતો.
items.why: "When it comes to marriage specifically" is Point 4's ともなると／となると, describing a shift in impression once a specific topic/threshold is reached.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 2 · 大学教授ですら

items.q: 親（ ）者は、子どもが悪いことをしたときに、きちんとしかるべきだ。
items.qr: Oya (___) mono wa, kodomo ga warui koto o shita toki ni, kichinto shikaru beki da.
items.en: Someone in the position of a parent should properly scold their child when they do something wrong.
items.hi: माँ-बाप की ज़िम्मेदारी है कि बच्चे के ग़लत काम करने पर उसे ठीक से डाँटा जाए।
items.gu: માતાપિતાની જવાબદારી છે કે બાળક ખોટું કામ કરે તો તેને બરાબર ધમકાવવો.

opts.en: (wrong — this attaches directly, no に needed)

items.why: たる attaches directly to the noun (親たる者) — Point 3's N1たるN2 form; にたる inserts an unnecessary に.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 2 · 大学教授ですら

items.q: あのような一流レストラン（ ）と、男性はネクタイが必要だ。
items.qr: Ano you na ichiryuu resutoran (___) to, dansei wa nekutai ga hitsuyou da.
items.en: When it comes to a first-class restaurant like that, men need to wear a tie.
items.hi: उस तरह के प्रथम श्रेणी के रेस्तराँ की बात आते ही, पुरुषों को टाई पहननी ज़रूरी हो जाती है।
items.gu: તે પ્રકારની પ્રથમ કક્ષાની રેસ્ટોરન્ટની વાત આવે ત્યારે, પુરુષોએ ટાઈ પહેરવી જરૂરી બને છે.

opts.en: once it becomes (+ と outside completes ともなると)
of the standing of (wrong — this criticizes a person's status, not a venue threshold)

items.why: Reaching the threshold of "a first-class restaurant" changing dress expectations is Point 4's ともなると; ともあろう (Point 3) is reserved for criticizing a person/entity for not living up to their status, not describing a venue's dress code.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 2 · 大学教授ですら

items.q: 結婚なんてとんでもない。私は男の人と話したこと（ ）ないのです。
items.qr: Kekkon nante tondemonai. Watashi wa otoko no hito to hanashita koto (___) nai no desu.
items.en: Marriage is out of the question. I haven't even ever talked to a man.
items.hi: शादी की तो बात ही मत करो। मैंने तो किसी लड़के से बात भी नहीं की है।
items.gu: લગ્નની તો વાત જ ના કરો. મેં તો કોઈ છોકરા સાથે વાત પણ નથી કરી.

opts.en: (wrong — こと doesn't need に before すら here)

items.why: すら attaches directly after こと (話したことすら) — Point 1's extreme-example emphasis, citing "never having even talked to a man" as the extreme baseline.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 2 · 大学教授ですら

items.q: 盗みが悪いことであるのは、小さい子ども（ ）知っている。
items.qr: Nusumi ga warui koto de aru no wa, chiisai kodomo (___) shitte iru.
items.en: Even small children know that stealing is wrong.
items.hi: चोरी करना बुरी बात है, यह तो छोटे बच्चे भी जानते हैं।
items.gu: ચોરી કરવી ખરાબ વાત છે, એ તો નાનાં બાળકો પણ જાણે છે.

opts.en: once it comes to (wrong — no threshold being crossed here)

items.why: Citing "even small children" as the extreme baseline of common knowledge is Point 1's ですら.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 2 · 大学教授ですら

items.q: 旅行をしている間ずっと、ごちそう（ ）で、少し太ってしまいました。
items.qr: Ryokou o shite iru aida zutto, gochisou (___) de, sukoshi futotte shimaimashita.
items.en: The whole trip was nothing but feasting, so I gained a bit of weight.
items.hi: पूरी यात्रा में सिर्फ़ शानदार खाना ही खाना मिला, तो थोड़ा वज़न बढ़ गया।
items.gu: સંપૂર્ણ સફરમાં ફક્ત ભોજન જ ભોજન હતું, તો થોડું વજન વધી ગયું.

opts.en: covered in (wrong — feasting isn't a dirty coating)

items.why: A trip consisting entirely of feasting is Point 1's ずくめ; まみれ is reserved for being physically covered in something unpleasant, which doesn't fit "feasting."
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 家族ぐるみ

items.q: 初めてのスキーでは転んでばかりで、雪（ ）になってしまった。
items.qr: Hajimete no sukii de wa koronde bakari de, yuki (___) ni natte shimatta.
items.en: On my first time skiing, I kept falling and ended up covered in snow.
items.hi: पहली बार स्कीइंग करते हुए बार-बार गिरा और पूरी तरह बर्फ़ से ढक गया।
items.gu: પહેલી વાર સ્કીઇંગ કરતાં વારંવાર પડ્યો અને સંપૂર્ણપણે બરફથી ઢંકાઈ ગયો.

opts.en: nothing but (wrong — being covered in snow from falling isn't a "uniform look")

items.why: Being physically covered in snow from repeated falls is Point 2's まみれ.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 家族ぐるみ

items.q: その企業が会社（ ）で脱税をしていたのが発覚した。
items.qr: Sono kigyou ga kaisha (___) de datsuzei o shite ita no ga hakkaku shita.
items.en: It came to light that the company as a whole had been evading taxes.
items.hi: यह सामने आया कि उस कंपनी में पूरे संस्थान की मिलीभगत से टैक्स चोरी हो रही थी।
items.gu: એ સામે આવ્યું કે તે કંપનીમાં સંપૂર્ણ સંસ્થાની મિલીભગતથી ટેક્સ ચોરી થઈ રહી હતી.

opts.en: nothing but (wrong — this isn't describing an exclusive quality)

items.why: Tax evasion involving the entire company (not just one person) is Point 3's ぐるみ — collective, often complicit, involvement.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 家族ぐるみ

items.q: カラスは人間（ ）の知能があるといわれています。
items.qr: Karasu wa ningen (___) no chinou ga aru to iwarete imasu.
items.en: Crows are said to have intelligence on par with humans.
items.hi: कहा जाता है कि कौवों में इंसानों जैसी बुद्धि होती है।
items.gu: કહેવાય છે કે કાગડાઓમાં માણસો જેવી બુદ્ધિ હોય છે.

opts.en: the whole of ~ together (wrong — this isn't collective involvement)

items.why: Comparing crow intelligence to a human benchmark is Point 4's 並み.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 家族ぐるみ

items.q: 夏の海岸で砂（ ）になって遊んだ。
items.qr: Natsu no kaigan de suna (___) ni natte asonda.
items.en: I played on the summer beach until I was covered in sand.
items.hi: गर्मियों के समुद्र तट पर पूरी तरह रेत से लथपथ होकर खेला।
items.gu: ઉનાળાના દરિયાકિનારે સંપૂર્ણપણે રેતીથી લપેટાઈને રમ્યો.

opts.en: the whole of ~ together (wrong — not a group activity, just physically covered)

items.why: Being physically covered in sand while playing is Point 2's まみれ.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 3 · 家族ぐるみ

items.q: 僕の幸せは家族（ ）ものだ。みんな病気をせず元気でいてほしい。
items.qr: Boku no shiawase wa kazoku (___) mono da. Minna byouki o sezu genki de ite hoshii.
items.en: My happiness only exists because of my family. I want everyone to stay healthy and well.
items.hi: मेरी ख़ुशी परिवार की वजह से ही है। चाहता हूँ सब बीमार न पड़ें और स्वस्थ रहें।
items.gu: મારી ખુશી પરિવારના કારણે જ છે. ઈચ્છું છું બધા બીમાર ન પડે અને સ્વસ્થ રહે.
items.why: Point 4's あっての attaches directly to the noun (家族あっての); にあっての isn't a valid combination.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · この状況にあって

items.q: 父は、たとえ日曜であっても、仕事（ ）どこへでも行く。
items.qr: Chichi wa, tatoe nichiyou de atte mo, shigoto (___) doko e demo iku.
items.en: My father will go anywhere if it's for work, even on a Sunday.
items.hi: पापा, इतवार भी हो, तो भी काम की बात हो तो कहीं भी चले जाते हैं।
items.gu: પપ્પા, રવિવાર પણ હોય, તો પણ કામની વાત હોય તો ક્યાંય પણ જાય છે.

opts.en: if it's the case that (then anything)
under the circumstances of (wrong — this sets a scene, not a devoted willingness)

items.why: Willingness to go anywhere for work is Point 2's とあれば; にあって would just describe a circumstance, not devotion/willingness.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · この状況にあって

items.q: 事業の成功は、皆さんの協力（ ）ものと感謝しています。
items.qr: Jigyou no seikou wa, minasan no kyouryoku (___) mono to kansha shite imasu.
items.en: I'm grateful that the success of this venture only exists thanks to everyone's cooperation.
items.hi: इस व्यवसाय की सफलता सबके सहयोग की वजह से ही है, इसके लिए आभारी हूँ।
items.gu: આ ધંધાની સફળતા બધાના સહયોગના કારણે જ છે, તે માટે આભારી છું.
items.why: Success existing only because of everyone's cooperation is Point 4's あっての; とあっての incorrectly combines と with this pattern.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · この状況にあって

items.q: 決勝戦（ ）、その試合の入場券はすぐに売り切れた。
items.qr: Kesshousen (___), sono shiai no nyuujouken wa sugu ni urikireta.
items.en: Since it was the final match, the tickets sold out right away.
items.hi: फ़ाइनल मैच होने की वजह से, उसके टिकट फ़ौरन बिक गए।
items.gu: ફાઇનલ મેચ હોવાના કારણે, તેની ટિકિટ તરત વેચાઈ ગઈ.

opts.en: under the circumstances of (wrong — this sets a scene, not a causal explanation)

items.why: Explaining why the tickets sold out (because it's the final) is Point 1's とあって.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · この状況にあって

items.q: 情報が氾濫する時代（ ）、必要なものを選択するのは難しい。
items.qr: Jouhou ga hanran suru jidai (___), hitsuyou na mono o sentaku suru no wa muzukashii.
items.en: In an era overflowing with information, it's difficult to choose what's necessary.
items.hi: जानकारी की भरमार वाले इस दौर में, ज़रूरी चीज़ें चुनना मुश्किल है।
items.gu: માહિતીના ભરાવાવાળા આ યુગમાં, જરૂરી ચીજો પસંદ કરવી મુશ્કેલ છે.

opts.en: (incomplete — needs に before it for this formal "under the circumstances" sense)

items.why: Setting the scene of a formal "in this era..." observation is Point 3's にあって; bare あって without に isn't the correct fixed form here.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 4 · この状況にあって

items.q: 「鈴木」なんていう名前、この町に千から（ ）んだよ。どうやって彼を探すんだよ。
items.qr: "Suzuki" nante iu namae, kono machi ni sen kara (___) n da yo. Dou yatte kare o sagasu n da yo.
items.en: There are as many as a thousand people named "Suzuki" in this town. How am I supposed to find him?
items.hi: "सुज़ुकी" नाम वाले इस शहर में कम से कम एक हज़ार लोग हैं। उसे कैसे ढूँढूँ?
items.gu: "સુઝુકી" નામવાળા આ શહેરમાં ઓછામાં ઓછા હજાર લોકો છે. તેને કેવી રીતે શોધું?
items.why: 千からある ("as many as a thousand") is Point 1's count emphasis — the whole point is that there are too many people with that name.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 5 · あなたならでは

items.q: 300枚（ ）CDの置き場に困っている。
items.qr: Sanbyaku-mai (___) CD no okiba ni komatte iru.
items.en: I'm having trouble finding storage space for as many as 300 (or more) CDs.
items.hi: कम से कम 300 सीडी रखने की जगह ढूँढना मुश्किल हो रहा है।
items.gu: ઓછામાં ઓછી 300 સીડી રાખવાની જગ્યા શોધવી મુશ્કેલ છે.

opts.en: costing at least (wrong — 枚 counts items, not price)

items.why: 枚 (a counter for flat objects like CDs) is a count/number, which takes からある, not からする (reserved for prices).
items.unit: Week 4 Day 5 · あなたならでは

items.q: お米一粒（ ）粗末にするなと、よく祖母から言われた。
items.qr: Okome hito-tsubu (___) somatsu ni suru na to, yoku sobo kara iwareta.
items.en: My grandmother often told me not to waste even a single grain of rice.
items.hi: दादी अक्सर कहती थीं कि चावल का एक भी दाना बर्बाद मत करो।
items.gu: દાદી ઘણી વાર કહેતાં કે ચોખાનો એક પણ દાણો બગાડ ન કરો.

opts.en: as many as (wrong — this emphasizes a large amount, not denies a tiny one)

items.why: "Not even a single grain" is Point 2's たりとも, denying the smallest possible unit; からある would (wrongly) emphasize a large quantity instead.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 5 · あなたならでは

items.q: 桜の木の下で酒を飲んで歌を歌う。日本（ ）お花見の風景だ。
items.qr: Sakura no ki no shita de sake o nonde uta o utau. Nihon (___) ohanami no fuukei da.
items.en: Drinking and singing under the cherry blossoms — a scene of flower-viewing unique to Japan.
items.hi: चेरी के पेड़ों के नीचे शराब पीना और गाना गाना — यह जापान की ही ख़ास फूल देखने की परंपरा है।
items.gu: ચેરીના વૃક્ષો નીચે દારૂ પીવો અને ગીતો ગાવાં — આ જાપાનની જ ખાસ ફૂલ જોવાની પરંપરા છે.
items.why: This flower-viewing custom being distinctively Japanese is Point 4's ならでは; ならでもの isn't a recognized grammatical form.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 5 · あなたならでは

items.q: その若者と話してみて、多少（ ）共感できることがあった。
items.qr: Sono wakamono to hanashite mite, tashou (___) kyoukan dekiru koto ga atta.
items.en: After talking with that young person, there were things I could relate to, at least to some extent.
items.hi: उस युवा से बात करने पर, कुछ बातों से थोड़ा-बहुत जुड़ाव महसूस हुआ।
items.gu: તે યુવાન સાથે વાત કરીને, કેટલીક બાબતોમાં થોડું ઘણું જોડાણ અનુભવાયું.
items.why: 多少なりとも ("even just a little") is Point 3's fixed collocation with 多少; だけとも isn't a recognized combination.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 5 · あなたならでは

items.q: お金と時間をかければ、私にだってそれはできない（ ）。
items.qr: Okane to jikan o kakereba, watashi ni datte sore wa dekinai (___).
items.en: If I put in enough money and time, it's not impossible for me to do that either.
items.hi: पैसा और समय लगाया जाए, तो मेरे लिए भी यह करना नामुमकिन नहीं है।
items.gu: પૈસા અને સમય લગાવવામાં આવે, તો મારા માટે પણ આ કરવું અશક્ય નથી.

opts.en: (wrong — this would express strong refusal/rhetorical denial, not a hedge)

items.why: Leaving open a real possibility given enough resources is Point 2's ないものでもない; ものか is an entirely different, much stronger rhetorical-denial pattern (not covered this week).
items.unit: Week 4 Day 6 · なんとかならないものか

items.q: 字がきれいに書ける方法は（ ）だろうか。
items.qr: Ji ga kirei ni kakeru houhou wa (___) darou ka.
items.en: Isn't there some way to write neatly?
items.hi: क्या साफ़-सुथरी लिखावट सीखने का कोई तरीक़ा नहीं है?
items.gu: શું સ્વચ્છ અક્ષર લખવાનો કોઈ રસ્તો નથી?

opts.en: (wrong — this pattern specifically uses もの, not こと)

items.why: Wishing for a method to exist is Point 4's ないものだろうか; the fixed pattern always uses もの, never こと.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 6 · なんとかならないものか

items.q: 彼女が腹を立てるのも（ ）が、そんなに怒らなくてもいいだろう。
items.qr: Kanojo ga hara o tateru no mo (___) ga, sonna ni okoranakute mo ii darou.
items.en: I can understand her getting angry to some extent, but she doesn't need to be that mad.
items.hi: उसका गुस्सा होना समझ में आता है, लेकिन इतना ग़ुस्सा करने की ज़रूरत नहीं थी।
items.gu: તેનો ગુસ્સો સમજી શકાય એવો છે, પણ આટલો ગુસ્સો કરવાની જરૂર નહોતી.

opts.en: I do understand, to some extent

items.why: A hedged "I do understand" before a "but" is exactly Point 1's わからなくはない.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 6 · なんとかならないものか

items.q: 彼女の声の大きいのはもう少しどうにか（ ）ものだろうか。
items.qr: Kanojo no koe no ookii no wa mou sukoshi dou ni ka (___) mono darou ka.
items.en: Isn't there some way to tone down how loud her voice is, even a little?
items.hi: उसकी तेज़ आवाज़ को थोड़ा कम करने का कोई तरीक़ा नहीं है क्या?
items.gu: તેના મોટા અવાજને થોડો ઓછો કરવાનો કોઈ રસ્તો નથી શું?

opts.en: it's not that there isn't (wrong — this is Point 1's hedge, not a wish for change)
(completing どうにかならないものか, "can't something be done")
opts.hi: कुछ किया नहीं जा सकता क्या

items.why: どうにかならないものだろうか is Point 4's fixed wish pattern — なくもない would instead be Point 1's unrelated hedge.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 6 · なんとかならないものか

items.q: 彼の練習量は、ほかの選手と（ ）くらい多い。
items.qr: Kare no renshuuryou wa, hoka no senshu to (___) kurai ooi.
items.en: The amount he practices is so much more than the other athletes that it's beyond comparison.
items.hi: उसकी प्रैक्टिस की मात्रा, दूसरे खिलाड़ियों से तुलना ही न की जा सके, इतनी ज़्यादा है।
items.gu: તેની પ્રેક્ટિસની માત્રા, બીજા ખેલાડીઓ સાથે સરખામણી જ ન થઈ શકે, એટલી વધારે છે.

opts.t: 比べることにならない

items.why: Point 3's fixed idiom 比べものにならない always uses もの, not こと.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 6 · なんとかならないものか

items.q: 医者（ ）者が金もうけばかり考えてはいけない。
items.qr: Isha (___) mono ga kanemouke bakari kangaete wa ikenai.
items.en: Those of the standing of a doctor shouldn't only think about making money.
items.hi: डॉक्टर होने की हैसियत वालों को सिर्फ़ पैसा कमाने के बारे में नहीं सोचना चाहिए।
items.gu: ડોક્ટર હોવાની હેસિયતવાળાએ ફક્ત પૈસા કમાવવા વિશે જ ન વિચારવું જોઈએ.

opts.en: even (wrong — no extreme example being cited)

items.why: Week 4 Day 2's N1たるN2 criticizes someone for not living up to their professional status.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 高校生（ ）、ファッションに敏感になるものだ。
items.qr: Koukousei (___), fasshon ni binkan ni naru mono da.
items.en: Once one becomes a high schooler, one naturally becomes sensitive to fashion.
items.hi: हाई स्कूल की उम्र आते ही, फ़ैशन को लेकर सजग हो जाते हैं।
items.gu: હાઈસ્કૂલની ઉંમર આવતાં જ, ફેશન અંગે સજાગ થઈ જવાય છે.

opts.en: even/at the same time (wrong — no authority or dual role being cited)
under the circumstances of (wrong — no formal scene-setting here)
unique to (wrong — not describing an exclusive quality)

items.why: Reaching the threshold of "high schooler" naturally changes one's fashion sensitivity — Week 4 Day 2's ともなると.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 家で楽しく運動できる（ ）、そのゲームの人気が高いのもうなずける。
items.qr: Ie de tanoshiku undou dekiru (___), sono geemu no ninki ga takai no mo unazukeru.
items.en: Given that one can exercise enjoyably at home, it's understandable that the game is so popular.
items.hi: अगर घर पर मज़े से कसरत हो सकती है, तो उस गेम का लोकप्रिय होना समझ में आता है।
items.gu: જો ઘરે મજાથી કસરત થઈ શકે, તો તે ગેમનું લોકપ્રિય હોવું સમજી શકાય છે.
items.why: Week 4 Day 4's とあれば sets up the condition that makes the game's popularity understandable.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 魚（ ）漁業なのに、最近は魚が少なくなってしまった。
items.qr: Sakana (___) gyogyou na noni, saikin wa sakana ga sukunaku natte shimatta.
items.en: It's a fishing industry that exists only because of fish, yet recently fish have become scarce.
items.hi: यह मछली की वजह से ही मौजूद मछली-पालन उद्योग है, फिर भी हाल में मछलियाँ कम हो गई हैं।
items.gu: આ માછલીના કારણે જ અસ્તિત્વમાં માછીમારી ઉદ્યોગ છે, છતાં હાલમાં માછલીઓ ઓછી થઈ ગઈ છે.

opts.en: without ~, there is no (wrong grammatical fit here)
costing at least (wrong — 漁業 isn't a price)

items.why: Week 4 Day 4's N1あってのN2 — the fishing industry only exists because fish exist.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 海外に転勤になった。（ ）が、楽しみでもある。
items.qr: Kaigai ni tenkin ni natta. (___) ga, tanoshimi de mo aru.
items.en: I got transferred abroad. It's not that there's no anxiety at all, but it's also something to look forward to.
items.hi: विदेश तबादला हो गया। चिंता बिल्कुल नहीं है ऐसा नहीं है, लेकिन यह ख़ुशी की बात भी है।
items.gu: વિદેશ બદલી થઈ ગઈ. ચિંતા બિલકુલ નથી એવું નથી, પણ આ ખુશીની વાત પણ છે.

opts.en: (states flatly there's no anxiety — contradicts the hedge needed)
(states flatly there's not even anxiety — too strong)
it's not that there's no anxiety at all

items.why: Week 4 Day 6's double-negative なくはない softly admits some anxiety exists, fitting the contrast with "but it's also exciting."
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 私の本が、多少（ ）若い人たちにいい影響を与えているとしたらうれしい限りです。
items.qr: Watashi no hon ga, tashou (___) wakai hitotachi ni ii eikyou o ataete iru to shitara ureshii kagiri desu.
items.en: If my book is having even a slight good influence on young people, I'd be extremely happy.
items.hi: अगर मेरी किताब का युवाओं पर थोड़ा-सा भी अच्छा असर हो रहा हो, तो मुझे बहुत ख़ुशी होगी।
items.gu: જો મારા પુસ્તકની યુવાનો પર થોડી પણ સારી અસર થઈ રહી હોય, તો મને ખૂબ ખુશી થશે.

opts.en: if it's the case that (wrong — doesn't fit 多少's meaning)

items.why: Week 4 Day 5's 多少なりとも is the fixed collocation meaning "even just a little."
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 彼女の悪口など一言（ ）言ったことはありませんよ。
items.qr: Kanojo no waruguchi nado hitokoto (___) itta koto wa arimasen yo.
items.en: I've never said even a single word of criticism about her.
items.hi: मैंने उसके बारे में एक शब्द भी बुरा नहीं कहा है।
items.gu: મેં તેના વિશે એક શબ્દ પણ ખરાબ કહ્યો નથી.
items.why: Week 4 Day 5's たりとも denies even the smallest unit — one word.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 事件を起こしたのは彼だが、私に責任が（ ）。
items.qr: Jiken o okoshita no wa kare da ga, watashi ni sekinin ga (___).
items.en: He's the one who caused the incident, but it's not that I bear no responsibility at all.
items.hi: घटना उसने की, लेकिन यह भी नहीं कि मेरी कोई ज़िम्मेदारी नहीं है।
items.gu: ઘટના તેણે કરી, પણ એ પણ નથી કે મારી કોઈ જવાબદારી નથી.

opts.en: it's not that there's none at all

items.why: Week 4 Day 6's ないものでもない softly admits some responsibility might exist.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 住民の協力（ ）、ゴミの削減はできない。
items.qr: Juumin no kyouryoku (___), gomi no sakugen wa dekinai.
items.en: Without residents' cooperation, waste reduction is impossible.
items.hi: निवासियों के सहयोग के बिना, कचरा कम करना संभव नहीं है।
items.gu: રહેવાસીઓના સહયોગ વગર, કચરો ઘટાડવો શક્ય નથી.

opts.en: (wrong — this expresses regret, not a necessary precondition)

items.why: Week 4 Day 1's なくして asserts residents' cooperation as an essential precondition.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: A社の今回の人事は異例（ ）だった。
items.qr: A-sha no konkai no jinji wa irei (___) datta.
items.en: This personnel decision by Company A was full of irregularities.
items.hi: कंपनी A का यह मानव संसाधन फ़ैसला पूरी तरह असाधारण था।
items.gu: કંપની A નો આ કર્મચારી નિર્ણય સંપૂર્ણપણે અસાધારણ હતો.

opts.en: covered all over in (wrong — 異例 isn't a dirty coating)
the whole of ~ together (wrong — no group involvement here)

items.why: Week 4 Day 3's ずくめ describes a decision consisting entirely of irregularities.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 国際化の時代（ ）、我が社の保守的なやり方は世界に通用しないのではないだろうか。
items.qr: Kokusaika no jidai (___), wagasha no hoshuteki na yarikata wa sekai ni tsuuyou shinai no de wa nai darou ka.
items.en: In this era of globalization, isn't it the case that our company's conservative approach won't work internationally?
items.hi: इस वैश्वीकरण के दौर में, हमारी कंपनी का पुराना तरीक़ा दुनिया में नहीं चलेगा क्या?
items.gu: આ વૈશ્વિકરણના યુગમાં, અમારી કંપનીની જૂની પદ્ધતિ દુનિયામાં નહીં ચાલે શું?
items.why: Week 4 Day 4's にあって formally sets the scene of "this era of globalization."
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 試合中に大雨が降って泥（ ）になった。
items.qr: Shiaichuu ni ooame ga futte doro (___) ni natta.
items.en: Heavy rain fell during the match and everyone got covered in mud.
items.hi: मैच के दौरान भारी बारिश हुई और सब मिट्टी से लथपथ हो गए।
items.gu: મેચ દરમિયાન ભારે વરસાદ પડ્યો અને બધા માટીથી લથબથ થઈ ગયા.

opts.en: entirely/all (wrong — mud isn't a deliberate uniform look)
(wrong grammatical form — だらけ doesn't take の here)

items.why: Week 4 Day 3's まみれ describes being physically covered in mud.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 大企業（ ）、賃金が減らされるような状況だから、ボーナスのカットは避けられないだろう。
items.qr: Daikigyou (___), chingin ga herasareru you na joukyou dakara, boonasu no katto wa sakerarenai darou.
items.en: Even when it comes to a major corporation, given that wages are being cut, bonus cuts are probably unavoidable.
items.hi: एक बड़ी कंपनी की बात हो, तब भी, जब वेतन में कटौती हो रही हो, तो बोनस में कटौती से बचना मुश्किल होगा।
items.gu: એક મોટી કંપનીની વાત હોય, તો પણ, જ્યારે પગારમાં ઘટાડો થઈ રહ્યો હોય, તો બોનસમાં ઘટાડો ટાળવો મુશ્કેલ હશે.

opts.en: if it's the case that (wrong fit — no devoted willingness here)
even just a little (wrong — 大企業 isn't a small quantity)

items.why: Week 4 Day 2's ともなると describes a shift in circumstance once the scale of "a major corporation" is reached — even they face wage cuts.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: この時計が100万円（ ）なんて、信じられない。
items.qr: Kono tokei ga hyaku-man-en (___) nante, shinjirarenai.
items.en: I can't believe this watch costs as much as 1,000,000 yen.
items.hi: यह घड़ी 10 लाख येन तक की है, यह मानने लायक़ ही नहीं।
items.gu: આ ઘડિયાળ 10 લાખ યેન સુધીની છે, એ માનવા જેવું જ નથી.

opts.en: of the standing of (wrong — a watch has no "status")

items.why: Week 4 Day 5's からする emphasizes a large price.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 彼はアマチュアだが、プロ（ ）の技術を持っている。
items.qr: Kare wa amachua da ga, puro (___) no gijutsu o motte iru.
items.en: He's an amateur, but has skills on par with a professional.
items.hi: वह शौकिया है, लेकिन उसका हुनर पेशेवर जितना है।
items.gu: તે શોખીન છે, પણ તેની કુશળતા વ્યાવસાયિક જેટલી છે.
items.why: Week 4 Day 3's 並み compares his skill to the professional benchmark.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 年とともにひどくなる体のだるさや疲れ、（ ）ものだろうかとお思いではありませんか。

opts.en: there's nothing to be done (wrong — too hopeless for this ad's tone)
(wrong — this states a wish directly, not the fixed rhetorical wish form)
isn't there some way to fix this

items.why: Week 4 Day 6's なんとかならないものか is the fixed rhetorical wish/plea this ad opens with.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 年齢のせいにして家で何を（ ）ぼーっとテレビを見て過ごす毎日はもったいないです。
items.why: Week 4 Day 1's ともなく describes an unfocused day with no particular activity in mind.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 本日は長年の実績のある当社（ ）商品をご紹介したいと思います。

opts.en: costing at least (wrong — no price context)

items.why: Week 4 Day 5's ならでは praises the product as distinctively exclusive to this company.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: …今や（ ）欠かさず公園へ散歩に行くのが日課になりました。

opts.en: even just a little (wrong — this needs a single unit, not a vague amount)
(not a valid combination — たりとも needs a single-unit counter)
(wrong tone — なりとも welcomes a minimum, doesn't fit "never skipping")

items.why: Week 4 Day 5's たりとも denies even a single day being skipped — matching 欠かさず ("without skipping").
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: …この不況下（ ）お客様にあまり負担をおかけするわけには参りません。

opts.en: even (wrong — no extreme example being cited)
only existing because of (wrong — no foundational priority being asserted)

items.why: Week 4 Day 4's とあって explains the circumstance (an economic downturn) behind the promise not to overburden customers.
items.unit: Week 4 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 帰りが遅くなってしまった。父にしかられないでは（ ）だろう。
items.qr: Kaeri ga osoku natte shimatta. Chichi ni shikararenai de wa (___) darou.
items.en: I got home late. There's no way I won't get scolded by my father.
items.hi: घर लौटने में देर हो गई। पिताजी की डांट खाए बिना बात नहीं बनेगी।
items.gu: ઘરે પાછા ફરવામાં મોડું થઈ ગયું. પિતાજીનો ઠપકો ખાધા વગર નહીં ચાલે.
items.why: Being scolded is an inevitable natural consequence for the speaker, not something an outside force is causing to someone else — that's すまない's territory (Point 2). おかない (Point 4) needs a causative/effect verb where the subject forces an outcome onto another party, which doesn't fit here.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 1 · 謝るだけではすまない

items.q: その劇は見る者全員に感動を（ ）ほどすばらしかった。
items.qr: Sono geki wa miru mono zen'in ni kandou o (___) hodo subarashikatta.
items.en: The play was so wonderful it was bound to move every single viewer.
items.hi: वह नाटक इतना शानदार था कि देखने वाले हर किसी को ज़रूर भावुक कर देता।
items.gu: તે નાટક એટલું અદભુત હતું કે જોનાર દરેકને ચોક્કસ ભાવુક કરી દે.

opts.t: 与えるだけではすまない

items.why: 感動を与える (to give/produce emotion in others) is exactly the causative-style, effect-on-others verb that おかない (Point 4) demands. だけではすまない (Point 3) is for "a minimal action isn't enough," which isn't the meaning here.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 1 · 謝るだけではすまない

items.q: それは法に触れる行為です。知らなかった（ ）ですよ。
items.qr: Sore wa hou ni fureru koui desu. Shiranakatta (___) desu yo.
items.en: That act breaks the law. "I didn't know" won't cut it as an excuse.
items.hi: वह क़ानून तोड़ने वाला काम है। "मुझे पता नहीं था" कहने से बात नहीं बनेगी।
items.gu: એ કાયદો તોડતું કૃત્ય છે. "મને ખબર નહોતી" કહેવાથી વાત નહીં પતે.

opts.en: won't be accepted as an excuse
opts.hi: बहाने के तौर पर काम नहीं आएगा

items.why: "知らなかった" is a flimsy excuse being judged insufficient — the だけでは／ではすまない family (Point 3) exists exactly for this "that alone won't settle it" meaning.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 1 · 謝るだけではすまない

items.q: 父が脳梗塞で倒れて入院したが、手術せずに（ ）よかった。
items.qr: Chichi ga noukousoku de taorete nyuuin shita ga, shujutsu sezu ni (___) yokatta.
items.en: My father collapsed from a stroke and was hospitalized, but I'm glad he didn't end up needing surgery.
items.hi: पिताजी को स्ट्रोक आने से अस्पताल में भर्ती करना पड़ा, लेकिन ऑपरेशन की ज़रूरत नहीं पड़ी, यह राहत की बात है।
items.gu: પિતાજીને સ્ટ્રોક આવવાથી હોસ્પિટલમાં દાખલ કરવા પડ્યા, પણ ઓપરેશનની જરૂર ન પડી એ સારું થયું.
items.why: This is the relief pattern from Point 1 (〜ずにすむ) — surgery turned out to be unnecessary. すまなくて would flip the meaning to "it's not okay that there was no surgery," the opposite of what the sentence intends.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 1 · 謝るだけではすまない

items.q: 税金は払いたくないが、払わず（ ）。
items.qr: Zeikin wa haraitakunai ga, harawazu (___).
items.en: I don't want to pay taxes, but there's no way around paying them.
items.hi: टैक्स देना नहीं चाहता, लेकिन दिए बिना कोई चारा नहीं है।
items.gu: ટેક્સ ભરવો નથી ગમતો, પણ ભર્યા વગર છૂટકો નથી.
items.why: Point 2's pattern is V-ない stem + ず + には + すまない — the particle that follows ず is には, never では (では attaches directly after a noun/plain form, as in Point 3's だけでは).
items.unit: Week 5 Day 1 · 謝るだけではすまない

items.q: 最終電車が行ってしまって、タクシーに（ ）お金が足りなかった。
items.qr: Saishuu densha ga itte shimatte, takushii ni (___) okane ga tarinakatta.
items.en: The last train had already left, and even though I wanted to take a taxi, I didn't have enough money.
items.hi: आख़िरी ट्रेन जा चुकी थी, टैक्सी लेना चाहा तो भी पैसे कम पड़ गए।
items.gu: છેલ્લી ટ્રેન જતી રહી હતી, ટેક્સી લેવા ઈચ્છ્યું તોપણ પૈસા ઓછા પડ્યા.
items.why: The following clause (お金が足りなかった) states the concrete reason the taxi couldn't be taken — exactly Point 4's "うにも + reason clause" structure. ようがない (Point 2) would need to mean "there's no method to board a taxi," which doesn't match a money-shortage reason.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 間に合いそうもない

items.q: できる限りやさしく言葉の意味を教えた。もうこれ以上、説明（ ）ない。
items.qr: Dekiru kagiri yasashiku kotoba no imi o oshieta. Mou kore ijou, setsumei (___) nai.
items.en: I explained the word's meaning as simply as I could. There's no more way to explain it than that.
items.hi: जितना सरल हो सका, उतना शब्द का अर्थ समझाया। अब इससे ज़्यादा समझाने का कोई तरीक़ा नहीं है।
items.gu: બની શકે એટલું સરળ રીતે શબ્દનો અર્થ સમજાવ્યો. હવે આનાથી વધુ સમજાવવાનો કોઈ રસ્તો નથી.
items.why: "There's no method left to explain further" is Point 2 (〜ようがない), attached here via の to the noun 説明. そうもない (Point 1) would mean "doesn't look like it will happen," which doesn't fit "no method remains."
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 間に合いそうもない

items.q: この雨はしばらくやみそう（ ）。
items.qr: Kono ame wa shibaraku yamisou (___).
items.en: This rain doesn't look like it will let up for a while.
items.hi: यह बारिश फ़िलहाल थमती नहीं लग रही।
items.gu: આ વરસાદ હાલ પૂરતો બંધ થાય તેમ લાગતું નથી.
items.why: Point 1's fixed form is 〜そうもない (or 〜そうにない) — 〜そうがない simply isn't a pattern; がない only attaches after よう (Point 2), never after そう.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 間に合いそうもない

items.q: 台風で川の水があふれ、橋を渡ろうにも（ ）。
items.qr: Taifuu de kawa no mizu ga afure, hashi o watarou ni mo (___).
items.en: The typhoon caused the river to overflow, so even if I wanted to cross the bridge, I couldn't.
items.hi: तूफ़ान से नदी का पानी उफन आया, पुल पार करना चाहूँ तो भी नहीं कर सकता।
items.gu: તોફાનથી નદીનું પાણી ઊભરાયું, પુલ પાર કરવા ઈચ્છું તોપણ કરી શકતો નથી.

opts.en: (double-marks the same idea — not the tested pattern)

items.why: This is the "same verb twice" flavor of Point 4 — 渡ろうにも + 渡れない (volitional + potential-negative of the identical verb), triggered by a concrete external cause (the flood). ようがない would be redundant stacked onto an already-potential form.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 間に合いそうもない

items.q: 飛び出してきた自転車を（ ）なく、ひいてしまった。
items.qr: Tobidashite kita jitensha o (___) naku, hiite shimatta.
items.en: A bicycle darted out and there was no way to avoid it, so I ended up hitting it.
items.hi: अचानक सामने आई साइकिल से बचने का कोई तरीक़ा नहीं था, इसलिए टकरा गया।
items.gu: અચાનક સામે આવેલી સાયકલથી બચવાનો કોઈ રસ્તો નહોતો, એટલે અથડાઈ ગયો.
items.why: "No method existed to avoid it" is Point 2's core meaning (〜ようがなく, continuative form). そうもない would mean "didn't look likely to avoid it" — a prediction, not a statement about the absence of any method, which doesn't fit a split-second accident.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 2 · 間に合いそうもない

items.q: 最近のテレビ番組（ ）コマーシャルが多すぎる。
items.qr: Saikin no terebi bangumi (___) komaasharu ga oosugiru.
items.en: Speaking of TV shows these days, there are way too many commercials.
items.hi: आजकल के टीवी कार्यक्रमों की तो बात ही मत करो, विज्ञापन बहुत ज़्यादा होते हैं।
items.gu: આજકાલના ટીવી કાર્યક્રમોની તો વાત જ ના કરો, જાહેરાતો બહુ વધારે હોય છે.

opts.hi: की तो बात ही मत करो
opts.gu: ની તો વાત જ ના કરો

items.why: The sentence is a complaint about a topic (too many commercials) — exactly Point 1's job. としたら means "if we suppose/assume X," a hypothetical unrelated to griping about a topic.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · すでに述べたごとく

items.q: グラフに示した（ ）、わが社の営業成績は伸びています。
items.qr: Gurafu ni shimeshita (___), wagasha no eigyou seiseki wa nobiteimasu.
items.en: As shown in the graph, our company's sales performance is growing.
items.hi: ग्राफ़ में दिखाए अनुसार, हमारी कंपनी का बिक्री प्रदर्शन बढ़ रहा है।
items.gu: ગ્રાફમાં દર્શાવ્યા મુજબ, અમારી કંપનીનું વેચાણ પ્રદર્શન વધી રહ્યું છે.
items.why: A comma and a full clause follow the blank, which calls for the adverbial/continuative ごとく (Point 3). ごとき is the attributive form and must be directly followed by a noun (as in Q3 and Q5 below) — it can't stand before a comma like this.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · すでに述べたごとく

items.q: その難問が小学生（ ）解けるわけがない。
items.qr: Sono nanmon ga shougakusei (___) tokeru wake ga nai.
items.en: There's no way a mere elementary schooler could solve that difficult problem.
items.hi: वह मुश्किल सवाल किसी मामूली प्राइमरी स्कूल के बच्चे से हल हो ही नहीं सकता।
items.gu: તે અઘરો પ્રશ્ન કોઈ સામાન્ય પ્રાથમિક શાળાના બાળકથી ઉકેલી શકાય જ નહીં.
items.why: The sentence belittles 小学生 as too lowly to solve the problem — exactly Point 4's Nごとき. ときたら would need to introduce a complaint-topic sentence, not fit inside this "impossible for a mere X" structure.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · すでに述べたごとく

items.q: 酒好きの父（ ）、毎晩ひどく酔っ払って帰ってくるので困る。
items.qr: Sakezuki no chichi (___), maiban hidoku yopparatte kaette kuru node komaru.
items.en: Speaking of my sake-loving father, he comes home terribly drunk every night, which is a problem.
items.hi: मेरे शराब-प्रेमी पिताजी की तो बात ही मत करो, हर रात बुरी तरह नशे में घर लौटते हैं, यह एक समस्या है।
items.gu: મારા દારૂ-પ્રેમી પિતાજીની તો વાત જ ના કરો, રોજ રાત્રે ખૂબ નશામાં ઘરે આવે છે, જે તકલીફદાયક છે.

opts.hi: की तो बात ही मत करो
opts.gu: ની તો વાત જ ના કરો

items.why: This is a textbook complaint about a family member — Point 1's exact use case. のごとく ("like/as father") would need a comparison target, but 父 here isn't being compared to anything; he's the topic being complained about.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · すでに述べたごとく

items.q: 子どものけんか（ ）に警察を呼ぶとは、大げさだ。
items.qr: Kodomo no kenka (___) ni keisatsu o yobu to wa, oogesa da.
items.en: Calling the police over a mere kids' quarrel is way overboard.
items.hi: बच्चों की मामूली-सी लड़ाई के लिए पुलिस बुलाना तो ज़्यादती है।
items.gu: બાળકોના સામાન્ય ઝઘડા માટે પોલીસ બોલાવવી એ અતિરેક છે.
items.why: けんかごとき belittles the quarrel as trivial — Point 4's Nごとき, directly followed by the particle に. ごとく would require an adverbial "as/like" reading, which doesn't fit "overreacting to a mere kids' quarrel."
items.unit: Week 5 Day 3 · すでに述べたごとく

items.q: 親として情けないことだが、今に（ ）娘の非行に気づかなかった。
items.qr: Oya to shite nasakenai koto da ga, ima ni (___) musume no hikou ni kizukanakatta.
items.en: It's pathetic as a parent, but I didn't notice my daughter's delinquency until now.
items.hi: माता-पिता होने के नाते शर्म की बात है, लेकिन अब तक मुझे बेटी की बदचलनी का पता ही नहीं चला।
items.gu: માતાપિતા તરીકે શરમની વાત છે, પણ અત્યાર સુધી મને દીકરીની બદચલણીની ખબર જ ન પડી.
items.why: The sentence marks a time span extending up to the present — Point 2's Nに至るまで ("even up to now"). に至っては (Point 1's variant) would instead mean "now that things have reached this stage," a different emphasis that doesn't fit a plain time-range statement.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 4 · 理由のいかんにかかわらず

items.q: 理由のいかんに（ ）、試験開始後の入室は認められません。
items.qr: Riyuu no ikan ni (___), shiken kaishi go no nyuushitsu wa mitomeraremasen.
items.en: Regardless of the reason, entering the room after the exam has started is not permitted.
items.hi: कारण चाहे जो भी हो, परीक्षा शुरू होने के बाद कमरे में प्रवेश की अनुमति नहीं है।
items.gu: કારણ ગમે તે હોય, પરીક્ષા શરૂ થયા પછી રૂમમાં પ્રવેશની મંજૂરી નથી.
items.why: A strict, absolute rule ("no entry after the exam starts, no matter the reason") calls for Point 4's いかんによらず. いたるまで (Point 2) marks a scope/range, not an unconditional rule, so it doesn't fit here.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 4 · 理由のいかんにかかわらず

items.q: 次の試験の成績いかん（ ）、進級もできなくなるので頑張るように。
items.qr: Tsugi no shiken no seiseki ikan (___), shinkyuu mo dekinaku naru node ganbaru you ni.
items.en: Depending on your results in the next exam, you might not even be able to advance a grade, so do your best.
items.hi: अगली परीक्षा के नतीजों के अनुसार, अगली कक्षा में भी प्रमोशन नहीं मिल सकता, इसलिए मेहनत करना।
items.gu: આગામી પરીક્ષાના પરિણામોના આધારે, આગલા ધોરણમાં પ્રમોશન પણ ન મળે, એટલે મહેનત કરજો.
items.why: The outcome (advancing a grade) genuinely depends on the exam results — Point 3's いかんでは. によらず would flip the meaning to "no matter the results," which contradicts the warning to work hard.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 4 · 理由のいかんにかかわらず

items.q: 今度の面接の結果（ ）、合格か不合格かが決まる。
items.qr: Kondo no mensetsu no kekka (___), goukaku ka fugoukaku ka ga kimaru.
items.en: Whether you pass or fail will be decided depending on the result of this interview.
items.hi: इस बार के इंटरव्यू के नतीजे के अनुसार ही पास या फ़ेल होना तय होगा।
items.gu: આ વખતના ઇન્ટરવ્યુના પરિણામના આધારે જ પાસ કે ફેલ થવાનું નક્કી થશે.
items.why: Pass/fail genuinely hinges on the interview result — Point 3's いかんで. にもかかわらず means "despite/in spite of," which needs a contradictory follow-up, not a dependency relationship.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 4 · 理由のいかんにかかわらず

items.q: 昨夜のホテル火災は大惨事に（ ）済んだ。
items.qr: Sakuya no hoteru kasai wa daisanji ni (___) sunda.
items.en: Last night's hotel fire didn't escalate into a major disaster.
items.hi: कल रात होटल में लगी आग बड़ी दुर्घटना बनने तक नहीं पहुँची।
items.gu: ગઈકાલે રાત્રે હોટેલમાં લાગેલી આગ મોટી દુર્ઘટના સુધી ન પહોંચી.
items.why: The fire was contained and did NOT become a major disaster — Point 1's negative variant 〜に至らず(に). 至って would claim it DID reach that point, the opposite of what happened.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 4 · 理由のいかんにかかわらず

items.q: その歌手の人気は日本だけ（ ）、アジアの国々にも広まった。
items.qr: Sono kashu no ninki wa Nihon dake (___), Ajia no kuniguni ni mo hiromatta.
items.en: That singer's popularity wasn't limited to Japan alone — it spread to Asian countries too.
items.hi: उस गायक की लोकप्रियता सिर्फ़ जापान तक सीमित नहीं रही, बल्कि एशियाई देशों तक भी फैल गई।
items.gu: તે ગાયકની લોકપ્રિયતા ફક્ત જાપાન પૂરતી મર્યાદિત ન રહી, પણ એશિયાના દેશો સુધી પણ ફેલાઈ.
items.why: The も that follows ("アジアの国々にも") signals an escalating scope beyond Japan — exactly Point 2's にとどまらず. によらず would mean "regardless of Japan," which doesn't fit a sentence about geographic spread.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 5 · 見かけによらず

items.q: 昨日は休日と久しぶりの晴天が（ ）、遊園地はとても混んでいた。
items.qr: Kinou wa kyuujitsu to hisashiburi no seiten ga (___), yuuenchi wa totemo konde ita.
items.en: Yesterday, the holiday combined with the first sunny day in a while, so the amusement park was very crowded.
items.hi: कल छुट्टी और काफ़ी दिनों बाद आई धूप के मेल से, मनोरंजन पार्क बहुत भीड़भाड़ वाला था।
items.gu: ગઈકાલે રજા અને ઘણા સમય પછી આવેલા તડકાના મેળથી, મનોરંજન પાર્ક ખૂબ ભીડભાડવાળું હતું.
items.why: Two separate factors (the holiday and the sunny weather) join together to cause the crowding — Point 3's と相まって. にとどまらず would need an escalating "not limited to X, also Y" structure, which doesn't match two causes merging into one effect.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 5 · 見かけによらず

items.q: 株の暴落はその年だけに（ ）年が明けても続いた。
items.qr: Kabu no bouraku wa sono toshi dake ni (___) toshi ga akete mo tsuzuita.
items.en: The stock market crash wasn't limited to that year alone — it continued into the new year too.
items.hi: शेयर बाज़ार की गिरावट उसी साल तक सीमित नहीं रही, बल्कि नए साल में भी जारी रही।
items.gu: શેરબજારનું ધોવાણ ફક્ત તે વર્ષ પૂરતું મર્યાદિત ન રહ્યું, પણ નવા વર્ષમાં પણ ચાલુ રહ્યું.
items.why: The crash's effects extend beyond the original year into the next — a scope escalation, Point 2's territory. よらず ("regardless of") doesn't carry that "and it kept going further" sense.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 5 · 見かけによらず

items.q: あの映画は主題歌の人気と（ ）大ヒットした。
items.qr: Ano eiga wa shudaika no ninki to (___) daihitto shita.
items.en: That movie became a huge hit, combined with the popularity of its theme song.
items.hi: वह फ़िल्म अपने थीम सॉन्ग की लोकप्रियता के साथ मिलकर एक बड़ी हिट बन गई।
items.gu: તે ફિલ્મ પોતાના થીમ સોંગની લોકપ્રિયતા સાથે ભળીને મોટી હિટ બની.
items.why: The film's quality and the theme song's popularity jointly produced the hit — Point 3's と相まって. とどまらず would demand an escalating "not just X, but also Y" frame, which doesn't match "combined with."
items.unit: Week 5 Day 5 · 見かけによらず

items.q: 駅前のそば屋は、古くてみすぼらしい外観（ ）おいしいと評判だ。
items.qr: Ekimae no sobaya wa, furukute misuborashii gaikan (___) oishii to hyouban da.
items.en: The soba shop by the station is reputed to be delicious, regardless of its old, shabby appearance.
items.hi: स्टेशन के पास वाली सोबा दुकान पुरानी और भद्दी दिखने के बावजूद स्वादिष्ट होने के लिए मशहूर है।
items.gu: સ્ટેશન પાસેની સોબા દુકાન જૂની અને ખરાબ દેખાવ છતાં સ્વાદિષ્ટ હોવા માટે પ્રખ્યાત છે.
items.why: This is Point 1's core pattern — appearance has no bearing on taste. によらず attaches directly to the noun 外観 with に, never で — でよらず simply isn't a grammatical form.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 5 · 見かけによらず

items.q: 妻は職場に復帰（ ）、1歳になる子どもの預け先を探している。
items.qr: Tsuma wa shokuba ni fukki (___), issai ni naru kodomo no azukesaki o sagashite iru.
items.en: My wife, in order to return to work, is looking for somewhere to leave our one-year-old child.
items.hi: मेरी पत्नी काम पर लौटने के लिए, अपने एक साल के बच्चे के लिए देखभाल की जगह ढूँढ रही है।
items.gu: મારી પત્ની કામ પર પાછા ફરવા માટે, પોતાના એક વર્ષના બાળક માટે સંભાળની જગ્યા શોધી રહી છે.
items.why: She has a clear goal (returning to work) driving her search for childcare — Point 1's べく. べからず is a prohibition ("must not"), which makes no sense attached to her own intended action.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 6 · ここに駐車するべからず

items.q: 人殺しの道具を作るなど許す（ ）ことだ。
items.qr: Hitogoroshi no dougu o tsukuru nado yurusu (___) koto da.
items.en: Making tools for killing people is an unforgivable thing to do.
items.hi: इंसानों को मारने के औज़ार बनाना जैसा काम अक्षम्य है।
items.gu: માણસોને મારવાનાં સાધનો બનાવવાં જેવું કામ અક્ષમ્ય છે.
items.why: The noun こと follows directly, requiring the attributive form べからざる (Point 4). べからず (Point 3) is sentence-final and can't sit in front of a noun.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 6 · ここに駐車するべからず

items.q: 「芝生に入る（ ）。」という立て札が立ててあった。
items.qr: "Shibafu ni hairu (___)." to iu tatefuda ga tatete atta.
items.en: There was a sign posted that said "Keep off the grass."
items.hi: वहाँ एक तख़्ती लगी थी जिस पर लिखा था "घास पर चलना मना है।"
items.gu: ત્યાં એક પાટિયું લગાવેલું હતું જેના પર લખ્યું હતું "ઘાસ પર ચાલવું નહીં."
items.why: A posted sign prohibiting entry is exactly Point 3's use case. べきだ means "should," the opposite instruction (it would tell people TO step on the grass), so it can't be what a "keep off" sign says.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 6 · ここに駐車するべからず

items.q: 戦争での体験は、だれにとっても忘る（ ）悲惨な出来事だ。
items.qr: Sensou de no taiken wa, dare ni totte mo wasuru (___) hisan na dekigoto da.
items.en: Wartime experiences are a tragic event that must never be forgotten, for anyone.
items.hi: युद्ध के अनुभव, हर किसी के लिए ऐसी दुखद घटना है जिसे कभी भुलाया नहीं जाना चाहिए।
items.gu: યુદ્ધના અનુભવો, દરેક માટે એવી કરુણ ઘટના છે જેને ક્યારેય ભૂલવી ન જોઈએ.
items.why: 悲惨な出来事 (a noun) follows directly, so the attributive べからざる (Point 4) is required. べく (Point 1, "in order to") describes a purpose behind an action, not a quality of a noun.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 6 · ここに駐車するべからず

items.q: 日本語能力試験のN1に合格する（ ）日夜勉強をしています。
items.qr: Nihongo nouryoku shiken no N1 ni goukaku suru (___) nichiya benkyou o shite imasu.
items.en: In order to pass N1 of the JLPT, I study day and night.
items.hi: जेएलपीटी N1 पास करने के लिए, मैं दिन-रात पढ़ाई करता हूँ।
items.gu: JLPT N1 પાસ કરવા માટે, હું રાત-દિવસ અભ્યાસ કરું છું.
items.why: The speaker is actively working toward a real, achievable goal — Point 1's べく. べくもない (Point 2) would deny the goal is even conceivable, which contradicts studying hard to reach it.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 6 · ここに駐車するべからず

items.q: 大学に合格したことを知らせたときの両親の（ ）は、想像以上のものだった。
items.qr: Daigaku ni goukaku shita koto o shiraseta toki no ryoushin no (___) wa, souzou ijou no mono datta.
items.en: The way my parents rejoiced when I told them I'd passed the university entrance exam was beyond anything I imagined.
items.hi: जब मैंने बताया कि मैं यूनिवर्सिटी में पास हो गया हूँ, तो मेरे माता-पिता जिस तरह ख़ुश हुए, वह मेरी सोच से भी ज़्यादा था।
items.gu: જ્યારે મેં જણાવ્યું કે હું યુનિવર્સિટીમાં પાસ થયો છું, ત્યારે મારા માતાપિતા જે રીતે ખુશ થયા, તે મારી કલ્પના કરતાં પણ વધારે હતું.
items.why: Day 2's manner-noun 〜よう (ます-stem + よう) turns 喜び into "the way [they] rejoiced" — exactly what's needed as the subject of は here.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: このホテルのバイキングは、すし、ステーキからラーメン（ ）、あらゆる料理がそろっている。
items.qr: Kono hoteru no baikingu wa, sushi, suteeki kara raamen (___), arayuru ryouri ga sorotte iru.
items.en: This hotel's buffet has every kind of dish, from sushi and steak all the way to ramen.
items.hi: इस होटल के बुफ़े में सुशी, स्टेक से लेकर रामेन तक, हर तरह का खाना मौजूद है।
items.gu: આ હોટેલના બુફેમાં સુશી, સ્ટીકથી લઈને રામેન સુધી, દરેક પ્રકારનું ભોજન છે.
items.why: Day 4's Nに至るまで, paired with から, marks the full range "from sushi to as far as ramen."
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: その記事を読んだとき、なんともたとえ（ ）恐ろしさに襲われた。
items.qr: Sono kiji o yonda toki, nantomo tatoe (___) osoroshisa ni osowareta.
items.en: When I read that article, I was struck by a terror beyond all description.
items.hi: वह लेख पढ़ते ही, मुझ पर एक ऐसा डर छा गया जिसे बयां करना नामुमकिन था।
items.gu: તે લેખ વાંચતાં જ, મારા પર એવો ડર છવાઈ ગયો જેને વર્ણવવો અશક્ય હતો.
items.why: Day 2's 〜ようのない (before a noun) says no method exists to describe the terror — a fixed pairing with たとえ, just like 富士山のたとえようのない美しさ from Day 2.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 彼女は美人の上にお金持ち（ ）ので、とてもうらやましい。
items.qr: Kanojo wa bijin no ue ni okanemochi (___) node, totemo urayamashii.
items.en: She's beautiful, and on top of that rich, so I'm terribly envious of her.
items.hi: वह ख़ूबसूरत है और साथ में अमीर भी है, इसलिए मुझे उससे बहुत ईर्ष्या होती है।
items.gu: તે સુંદર છે અને સાથે અમીર પણ છે, એટલે મને તેની ખૂબ ઈર્ષ્યા થાય છે.
items.why: Day 3's 〜ときている stacks two enviable qualities (beautiful, and on top of that rich) to explain why envy naturally follows.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: うちの息子は、見かけ（ ）繊細な神経をしています。
items.qr: Uchi no musuko wa, mikake (___) sensai na shinkei o shite imasu.
items.en: My son, despite his looks, has a very delicate/sensitive temperament.
items.hi: मेरा बेटा, अपनी शक्ल-सूरत के उलट, बहुत नाज़ुक स्वभाव का है।
items.gu: મારો દીકરો, પોતાના દેખાવથી ઊલટું, ખૂબ સંવેદનશીલ સ્વભાવનો છે.

opts.en: speaking of (wrong fit, no complaint here)

items.why: Day 5's Nによらず — his delicate nature has nothing to do with his appearance, the classic "looks can be deceiving" use.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: それは（ ）忘れられない出来事だった。
items.qr: Sore wa (___) wasurerarenai dekigoto datta.
items.en: It was an event that I couldn't forget no matter how hard I tried.
items.hi: वह ऐसी घटना थी जिसे भुलाना चाहूँ तो भी भुला नहीं पाता।
items.gu: તે એવી ઘટના હતી જેને ભૂલવા ઈચ્છું તોપણ ભૂલી શકતો નથી.
items.why: Day 2's 〜（よ）うにも〜ない (same verb twice) — 忘れようにも忘れられない, "even trying to forget, I can't."
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 友人が掃除機を譲ってくれたので、（ ）よかった。
items.qr: Yuujin ga soujiki o yuzutte kureta node, (___) yokatta.
items.en: A friend gave me their vacuum cleaner, so I'm glad I didn't have to buy one.
items.hi: दोस्त ने अपना वैक्यूम क्लीनर दे दिया, तो अच्छा हुआ मुझे नया ख़रीदना नहीं पड़ा।
items.gu: મિત્રએ પોતાનું વેક્યુમ ક્લીનર આપી દીધું, તો સારું થયું મારે નવું ખરીદવું ન પડ્યું.
items.why: Day 1's 〜ずにすむ — the friend's gift made buying one unnecessary, textbook relief-pattern.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 先生なんだから、「わからない」（ ）でしょう。
items.qr: Sensei nan da kara, "wakaranai" (___) deshou.
items.en: Since you're the teacher, "I don't know" won't cut it as an answer.
items.hi: आप शिक्षक हैं, तो "मुझे नहीं पता" कहने से काम नहीं चलेगा।
items.gu: તમે શિક્ષક છો, તો "મને ખબર નથી" કહેવાથી નહીં ચાલે.

opts.en: won't be accepted as an excuse
(wrong particle — attaches after ず, not a quoted phrase)

items.why: Day 1's 〜ではすまない judges "I don't know" as an insufficient excuse for a teacher — the だけでは／ではすまない family.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 税金は（ ）ものだ。
items.qr: Zeikin wa (___) mono da.
items.en: Taxes are something you simply can't avoid paying.
items.hi: टैक्स ऐसी चीज़ है जिसे दिए बिना कोई चारा नहीं है।
items.gu: ટેક્સ એવી વસ્તુ છે જેને ભર્યા વગર છૂટકો નથી.

opts.en: (wrong fit — needs an effect on someone else)

opts.t: 払わずわけにはいかない
払わないにはいかない

items.why: Day 1's 〜ずにはすまない — this week's title phrase itself (努力せずにはすまない) uses the exact same pattern for an unavoidable obligation.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: リフォームをしただけだが、（ ）見違えるような家になった。
items.qr: Rifoomu o shita dake da ga, (___) michigaeru you na ie ni natta.
items.en: We only renovated it, but the house turned out looking as if it had been completely rebuilt.
items.hi: बस मरम्मत ही करवाई थी, लेकिन घर ऐसा हो गया मानो पूरा नया बना दिया गया हो।
items.gu: ફક્ત નવીનીકરણ જ કરાવ્યું હતું, પણ ઘર એવું બની ગયું જાણે સંપૂર્ણ નવેસરથી બાંધ્યું હોય.

opts.t: 建て直したかのごとく
opts.en: as if it had been rebuilt

items.why: Day 3's 〜かのごとく — the house looks "as if" fully rebuilt, though only renovated, the classic "as if" comparison.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 危険！この橋は渡る（ ）！
items.qr: Kiken! Kono hashi wa wataru (___)!
items.en: Danger! Do not cross this bridge!
items.hi: ख़तरा! इस पुल को पार करना मना है!
items.gu: ભય! આ પુલ પાર કરવો નહીં!
items.why: Day 6's 〜べからず — a blunt written warning sign, exactly like ここに駐車するべからず from Day 6 itself.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: その学生のスピーチは聞く者に感動を（ ）。
items.qr: Sono gakusei no supiichi wa kiku mono ni kandou o (___).
items.en: The student's speech never failed to move everyone who heard it.
items.hi: उस छात्र के भाषण ने सुनने वाले हर किसी को ज़रूर भावुक कर दिया।
items.gu: તે વિદ્યાર્થીના ભાષણે સાંભળનાર દરેકને ચોક્કસ ભાવુક કરી દીધો.

opts.t: 与えようにも与えなかった

opts.en: turned out unnecessary to give (wrong sense)

opts.t: 与えるべくもなかった
opts.en: wasn't even conceivable to give (wrong sense)

opts.t: 与えずにはおかなかった

items.why: Day 1's 〜ずにはおかない — the speech (an external stimulus) is guaranteed to move its listeners, the causative/effect-verb pattern.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 彼が日本を代表する作家であることは（ ）。
items.qr: Kare ga Nihon o daihyou suru sakka de aru koto wa (___).
items.en: That he is a writer who represents Japan is beyond doubt.
items.hi: वह जापान का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाला लेखक है, इसमें कोई शक़ ही नहीं है।
items.gu: તે જાપાનનું પ્રતિનિધિત્વ કરતો લેખક છે, તેમાં કોઈ શંકા જ નથી.
items.why: Day 6's 〜べくもない — his status is so obvious that even doubting it doesn't make sense, the "not even conceivable" pattern.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 晴天と相まって、この休みは（ ）。
items.qr: Seiten to aimatte, kono yasumi wa (___).
items.en: Combined with the sunny weather, a lot of people went cherry-blossom viewing this holiday.
items.hi: धूप के मौसम के साथ मिलकर, इस छुट्टी में बहुत लोग चेरी ब्लॉसम देखने गए।
items.gu: તડકાવાળા હવામાન સાથે ભળીને, આ રજામાં ઘણા લોકો ચેરી બ્લોસમ જોવા ગયા.

opts.t: 映画館はすいているに違いない
opts.r: eigakan wa suite iru ni chigainai
opts.en: the cinema must be empty (unrelated consequence)

opts.t: 花見をする人が多かった
opts.r: hanami o suru hito ga ookatta

opts.en: autumn is best for foliage (off-topic, wrong season link)

opts.t: 花火をおいてほかない

items.why: Day 5's 〜と相まって needs a result that plausibly follows from "sunny weather + holiday" combining — more people going out for hanami fits that combined cause directly; the other options don't follow logically from the stated combination.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 結果のいかんにかかわらず、（ ）。
items.qr: Kekka no ikan ni kakawarazu, (___).
items.en: Regardless of the result, the fact that you gave it your best should be recognized.
items.hi: नतीजा चाहे जो भी हो, पूरी कोशिश करने की बात को सराहा जाना चाहिए।
items.gu: પરિણામ ગમે તે હોય, પૂરો પ્રયત્ન કરવાની વાતને બિરદાવવી જોઈએ.

opts.t: 努力のしようにもできないことだろう
opts.r: doryoku no shiyou ni mo dekinai koto darou

opts.t: 努力することに至るだろう
opts.r: doryoku suru koto ni itaru darou

opts.t: ありえないくらい評価が悪かった
ベストを尽くしたことは評価すべきだ
opts.r: besuto o tsukushita koto wa hyouka subeki da
opts.en: the effort itself should be valued

items.why: Day 4's 〜いかんにかかわらず sets up an unconditional statement — only option 4 states something that holds true no matter the result; the others secretly depend on what the result actually was, contradicting "regardless."
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 「プローラ」は日本国内（ ）世界35か国で販売されており…
items.why: Day 5's Nにとどまらず — sales aren't confined to Japan; they extend (escalate) to 35 countries.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: …リコールのすべてをすぐには対応（ ）のが実情のようだ。

opts.en: manage without being able to (wrong sense)
(ungrammatical — べくもない attaches to a verb, not できる directly in this way)

items.why: Day 2's 〜そうもない — a realistic negative prediction about handling every recall promptly, given the staffing shortage.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: …昨年ようやく世界一の販売額を達成する（ ）だけに、失望も大きい。
items.why: Day 4's 〜に至る — finally reaching world-No.1 sales last year is the culmination this だけに ("precisely because") leans on for its "so the disappointment is bigger" logic.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: …これからの対応（ ）、販売額の減少（ ）問題に発展しそうだ。(first blank)
items.why: Day 4's Nいかんでは — how serious the fallout becomes genuinely depends on the company's future response, a conditional outcome.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: …販売額の減少（ ）問題に発展しそうだ。(second blank)

opts.en: (wrong particle — needs だけでは, not に)

items.why: Day 1's 〜だけではすまない — a sales decline alone isn't the end of it; the situation is set to escalate into something bigger.
items.unit: Week 5 Day 7 · 実戦問題

items.q: 去年の夏も雨が少なかったけれど、今年の水不足は去年（ ）深刻だ。
items.qr: Kyonen no natsu mo ame ga sukunakatta keredo, kotoshi no mizubusoku wa kyonen (___) shinkoku da.
items.en: Last summer had little rain too, but this year's water shortage is even more severe than last year's.
items.hi: पिछली गर्मियों में भी बारिश कम थी, लेकिन इस साल की पानी की कमी पिछले साल से भी ज़्यादा गंभीर है।
items.gu: ગયા ઉનાળામાં પણ વરસાદ ઓછો હતો, પણ આ વર્ષની પાણીની અછત ગયા વર્ષ કરતાં પણ વધુ ગંભીર છે.

opts.en: in line with (wrong — not a comparison here)

items.why: Comparing this year's shortage to an already-bad baseline (last year) and saying it's even worse is Point 2's にもまして.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 1 · 現状に即して

items.q: CDの発売に（ ）、そのアーチストのコンサートが開かれた。
items.qr: CD no hatsubai ni (___), sono aachisuto no konsaato ga hirakareta.
items.en: Ahead of the CD's release, that artist's concert was held.
items.hi: सीडी की रिलीज़ से पहले, उस कलाकार का संगीत समारोह आयोजित हुआ।
items.gu: સીડીના રિલીઝ પહેલાં, તે કલાકારનો સંગીત સમારોહ યોજાયો.

opts.en: in line with (wrong — no matching-a-standard sense here)

items.why: The concert happening before the CD's release is Point 1's 先駆けて.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 1 · 現状に即して

items.q: 音楽祭でのあの女性歌手の衣装は前回（ ）派手になっていた。
items.qr: Ongakusai de no ano josei kashu no ishou wa zenkai (___) hade ni natte ita.
items.en: That female singer's outfit at the music festival was even flashier than last time.
items.hi: संगीत समारोह में उस गायिका की पोशाक पिछली बार से भी ज़्यादा भड़कीली थी।
items.gu: સંગીત સમારોહમાં તે ગાયિકાનો પોશાક છેલ્લી વખત કરતાં પણ વધુ ભપકાદાર હતો.

opts.en: ahead of (wrong — not about being first)

items.why: Comparing this outfit's flashiness to the already-flashy previous one is Point 2's にもまして.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 1 · 現状に即して

items.q: 友人の息子の優秀なの（ ）、なんとうちの子の出来の悪いことか。
items.qr: Yuujin no musuko no yuushuu na no (___), nanto uchi no ko no deki no warui koto ka.
items.en: In contrast to my friend's excellent son, how poorly my own child performs!
items.hi: दोस्त के बेटे की क़ाबिलियत के मुक़ाबले, मेरे बच्चे का प्रदर्शन कितना कमज़ोर है!
items.gu: મિત્રના દીકરાની કુશળતાની સરખામણીમાં, મારા બાળકનું પ્રદર્શન કેટલું નબળું છે!

opts.en: even more than (wrong — this contrasts two different people, not exceeding a baseline)

items.why: Contrasting the friend's excellent son with the speaker's own underperforming child is Point 3's にひきかえ.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 1 · 現状に即して

items.q: 時代（ ）考え方をしないと若者には受け入れられない。
items.qr: Jidai (___) kangaekata o shinai to wakamono ni wa ukeirerarenai.
items.en: If you don't think in a way that matches the times, young people won't accept it.
items.hi: अगर समय के मुताबिक सोच नहीं रखेंगे, तो युवा उसे स्वीकार नहीं करेंगे।
items.gu: જો સમય મુજબ વિચાર નહીં રાખો, તો યુવાનો તેને સ્વીકારશે નહીં.

opts.en: (wrong — this contrasts two things, doesn't fit "matching the times")

items.why: A way of thinking that matches the current era is Point 4's に即した.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 1 · 現状に即して

items.q: 忙しかったので、あとでお昼を食べようと思っていたが、結局、食べず（ ）で、夕食の時間になった。
items.qr: Isogashikatta node, ato de ohiru o tabeyou to omotte ita ga, kekkyoku, tabezu (___) de, yuushoku no jikan ni natta.
items.en: I was busy, so I thought I'd have lunch later, but in the end I never got around to eating it, and dinner time arrived.
items.hi: व्यस्त था/थी, तो सोचा बाद में लंच कर लूँगा/लूँगी, लेकिन आख़िर तक खा ही नहीं पाया/पाई, और डिनर का समय आ गया।
items.gu: વ્યસ્ત હતો/હતી, તો વિચાર્યું પછી લંચ કરી લઈશ, પણ છેવટ સુધી ખાઈ જ ન શક્યો/શકી, અને ડિનરનો સમય આવી ગયો.

opts.en: (wrong — this needs じまい's "ended up never doing" flavor, not まま's passive-following sense)

items.why: Never getting around to eating lunch, with regret, is Point 4's ずじまい.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 冗談のつもりで

items.q: 感想を思う（ ）アンケートに書いてください。
items.qr: Kansou o omou (___) ankeeto ni kaite kudasai.
items.en: Please write your impressions in the questionnaire just as you think them.
items.hi: जो सोचते हैं, वही सर्वेक्षण में लिख दें।
items.gu: જે વિચારો છો, તે જ સર્વેમાં લખી દો.

opts.en: with the intention of (wrong — no mistaken self-image here)

items.why: Writing exactly what one thinks, unfiltered, is Point 2's ままに (思うまま); つもりで would need a gap between feeling and reality, which isn't present here.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 冗談のつもりで

items.q: 彼は目が見えず（ ）すばらしい演奏をして、観客に感動を与えた。
items.qr: Kare wa me ga miezu (___) subarashii ensou o shite, kankyaku ni kandou o ataeta.
items.en: Even without being able to see, he gave a wonderful performance and moved the audience.
items.hi: वह देख नहीं सकते होते हुए भी, ऐसा बेहतरीन प्रदर्शन किया कि दर्शक भावुक हो गए।
items.gu: તે જોઈ ન શકતા હોવા છતાં, એવો ઉત્તમ પ્રદર્શન કર્યો કે દર્શકો ભાવુક થઈ ગયા.

opts.en: ended up never (wrong — his performance clearly happened, nothing was left undone)

items.why: "Even without sight" is a concessive circumstance he performed despite — Point 3's ずとも; じまい would need something never accomplished, but he DID perform wonderfully.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 冗談のつもりで

items.q: 店員に勧められる（ ）、高いテレビを買ってしまった。
items.qr: Ten'in ni susumerareru (___), takai terebi o katte shimatta.
items.en: Persuaded by the shop clerk, I ended up buying an expensive TV.
items.hi: दुकानदार के कहने पर, बिना सोचे-समझे, महँगा टीवी ख़रीद लिया।
items.gu: દુકાનદારના કહેવા પર, વિચાર્યા વગર, મોંઘું ટીવી ખરીદી લીધું.

opts.en: with the intention of (wrong — no mistaken self-image)

items.why: Being talked into a purchase by the clerk's recommendation is Point 2's 勧められるままに.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 冗談のつもりで

items.q: 待ち合わせ場所を間違えたらしく、結局彼女とは（ ）じまいだった。
items.qr: Machiawase basho o machigaeta rashiku, kekkyoku kanojo to wa (___) jimai datta.
items.en: It seems we got the meeting place wrong, and in the end I never got to meet her.
items.hi: लगता है मिलने की जगह ग़लत हो गई थी, और आख़िर में उससे मिल ही नहीं पाया।
items.gu: લાગે છે મળવાની જગ્યા ખોટી થઈ ગઈ હતી, અને છેવટે તેને મળી જ ન શકાયું.

opts.en: (wrong — じまい needs the ず-stem, not plain ない)

items.why: ずじまい always attaches to the ず-negative stem, not the plain ない form — 会えず, not 会えない.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 2 · 冗談のつもりで

items.q: 人は外見より中身が重要であると（ ）、つい外見のよさに目を奪われてしまう。
items.qr: Hito wa gaiken yori nakami ga juuyou de aru to (___), tsui gaiken no yosa ni me o ubawarete shimau.
items.en: Even though people think character matters more than appearance, they inevitably end up captivated by good looks anyway.
items.hi: भले ही लोग सोचते हों कि दिखावे से ज़्यादा अंदर की बात मायने रखती है, फिर भी अनजाने में अच्छे दिखावे की तरफ़ आकर्षित हो ही जाते हैं।
items.gu: ભલે લોકો વિચારે કે દેખાવ કરતાં અંદરની વાત મહત્વની છે, છતાં અજાણતાં સારા દેખાવ તરફ ખેંચાઈ જ જાય છે.

opts.en: (wrong — this needs a concessive contrast, not a state description)

items.why: The sentence sets up a contradiction (believing X, yet doing Y anyway) — that's Point 2's concessive ながらも, not Point 1's state-describing ながらに.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 狭いながらも

items.q: この映画は話の内容（ ）映像の美しさも評判がいい。
items.qr: Kono eiga wa hanashi no naiyou (___) eizou no utsukushisa mo hyouban ga ii.
items.en: Not to mention this movie's story, its beautiful visuals are also highly praised.
items.hi: इस फ़िल्म की कहानी तो अच्छी है ही, इसके दृश्यों की सुंदरता भी बहुत सराही जाती है।
items.gu: આ ફિલ્મની વાર્તા તો સારી છે જ, તેના દ્રશ્યોની સુંદરતા પણ ખૂબ વખણાય છે.
items.why: Two praiseworthy qualities (story, visuals) are being listed together — Point 3's もさることながら.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 狭いながらも

items.q: 彼は転びそうになり（ ）急斜面をスキーで滑り降りた。
items.qr: Kare wa korobisou ni nari (___) kyuushamen o sukii de suberiorita.
items.en: Even though he nearly fell over, he skied down the steep slope.
items.hi: गिरते-गिरते बचते हुए भी, वह तेज़ ढलान पर स्की करते हुए उतर गया।
items.gu: પડતાં પડતાં બચીને પણ, તે તીવ્ર ઢોળાવ પર સ્કી કરીને ઊતરી ગયો.
items.why: Nearly falling but skiing down anyway is a concession — Point 2's ながらも.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 狭いながらも

items.q: 約束した（ ）、たとえ雪が降っても行かないわけにはいかない。
items.qr: Yakusoku shita (___), tatoe yuki ga futte mo ikanai wake ni wa ikanai.
items.en: Since I already promised, I can't not go even if it snows.
items.hi: जब वादा कर ही दिया, तो बर्फ़ गिरने पर भी न जाना ठीक नहीं होगा।
items.gu: જ્યારે વચન આપી જ દીધું, તો બરફ પડે તોપણ ન જવું યોગ્ય નહીં ગણાય.

opts.en: (wrong — 手前 needs the face-saving nuance here)

items.why: Having promised creates a social obligation not to back out — Point 4's 手前.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 狭いながらも

items.q: 8歳になる息子が子ども（ ）一生懸命お金を貯めて買ってくれた誕生日プレゼントは、一生の宝物だ。
items.qr: Hassai ni naru musuko ga kodomo (___) isshoukenmei okane o tamete katte kureta tanjoubi purezento wa, isshou no takaramono da.
items.en: The birthday present my eight-year-old son bought me — saving up his money hard, child that he is — is a treasure for life.
items.hi: मेरे आठ साल के बेटे ने, बच्चा होते हुए भी, मेहनत से पैसे बचाकर जो जन्मदिन का तोहफ़ा दिया, वह ज़िंदगी भर का ख़ज़ाना है।
items.gu: મારા આઠ વર્ષના દીકરાએ, બાળક હોવા છતાં, મહેનતથી પૈસા બચાવીને જે જન્મદિવસની ભેટ આપી, તે જીવનભરનો ખજાનો છે.

opts.en: child as he is / in his own childlike way

items.why: 子どもながらに is a fixed phrase using Point 1's state-describing ながらに — "in his own childlike way," describing the manner without changing it (still just a child, yet acting maturely).
items.unit: Week 6 Day 3 · 狭いながらも

items.q: 心を込めて作った料理なのに、子どもたちはまずい（ ）顔をゆがめた。
items.qr: Kokoro o komete tsukutta ryouri na noni, kodomo-tachi wa mazui (___) kao o yugameta.
items.en: Even though I cooked with care, the children screwed up their faces as if to say "this is gross."
items.hi: दिल से बनाया खाना था, फिर भी बच्चों ने मानो "यह बेस्वाद है" कहते हुए मुँह बना लिया।
items.gu: દિલથી બનાવેલું ભોજન હતું, છતાં બાળકોએ જાણે "આ સ્વાદિષ્ટ નથી" કહેતાં મોઢું બગાડ્યું.

opts.en: (wrong — not even, let alone; different pattern entirely)

items.why: Grimacing without saying a word, yet clearly conveying "this is bad" — Point 4's とばかりに.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 貧しさゆえに

items.q: うちの犬は僕を見ると（ ）ばかりの勢いで走ってきた。
items.qr: Uchi no inu wa boku o miru to (___) bakari no ikioi de hashitte kita.
items.en: When our dog saw me, it came running with enough force to nearly jump on me.
items.hi: हमारा कुत्ता मुझे देखते ही, मानो कूदकर लिपटने ही वाला हो, इतनी तेज़ी से दौड़ता आया।
items.gu: અમારો કૂતરો મને જોતાં જ, જાણે કૂદીને વળગવાનો જ હોય, એટલી ઝડપથી દોડતો આવ્યો.

opts.en: (wrong — needs the ん-stem before ばかり, not a plain past + と)

items.why: Point 3's んばかりの needs the negative-stem-derived ん form (飛びつかん), not a plain past-tense verb + と.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 貧しさゆえに

items.q: 彼女は疲れた（ ）、部屋に入るなりベッドに倒れ込んだ。
items.qr: Kanojo wa tsukareta (___), heya ni hairu nari beddo ni taorekonda.
items.en: As if to say "I'm exhausted," she collapsed onto the bed the moment she entered the room.
items.hi: मानो "थक गई हूँ" कहते हुए, कमरे में घुसते ही बिस्तर पर गिर पड़ी।
items.gu: જાણે "થાકી ગઈ છું" કહેતાં, રૂમમાં ઘૂસતાં જ પલંગ પર પડી ગઈ.

opts.hi: मानो थक गई हूँ कहते हुए

opts.en: (wrong — this is a stated cause, not body language)

items.why: Collapsing onto the bed silently conveys "I'm exhausted" without saying it — Point 4's とばかりに, not Point 1's causal ゆえに.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 貧しさゆえに

items.q: 彼は技術を極めん（ ）夜も眠らずに努力している。
items.qr: Kare wa gijutsu o kiwamen (___) yoru mo nemurazu ni doryoku shite iru.
items.en: He works hard without even sleeping at night, in order to master his skill.
items.hi: वह अपने हुनर में महारत हासिल करने के इरादे से रात को सोए बिना भी मेहनत करता है।
items.gu: તે પોતાની કળામાં નિપુણતા મેળવવાના ઇરાદાથી રાત્રે ઊંઘ્યા વગર પણ મહેનત કરે છે.

opts.hi: महारत हासिल करने के इरादे से

opts.en: (wrong — no "on the verge of" image here, this is about deliberate purpose)

items.why: Sacrificing sleep with driven purpose to master a skill is Point 2's んがために.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 貧しさゆえに

items.q: その病気に関する人々の知識のなさ（ ）、彼らは迫害された。
items.qr: Sono byouki ni kansuru hitobito no chishiki no nasa (___), karera wa hakugai sareta.
items.en: Because of people's lack of knowledge about that illness, they were persecuted.
items.hi: उस बीमारी के बारे में लोगों की जानकारी की कमी की वजह से, उन्हें सताया गया।
items.gu: તે બીમારી વિશે લોકોના જ્ઞાનની ઉણપને કારણે, તેમને સતાવવામાં આવ્યા.

opts.hi: जानकारी की कमी की वजह से

opts.en: (wrong — this states a real cause, not body language)

items.why: A stated, formal cause (lack of knowledge → persecution) is Point 1's ゆえに.
items.unit: Week 6 Day 4 · 貧しさゆえに

items.q: この仕事（ ）、彼にふさわしい仕事はほかにないでしょう。
items.qr: Kono shigoto (___), kare ni fusawashii shigoto wa hoka ni nai deshou.
items.en: There's probably no job other than this one that suits him so well.
items.hi: इस काम के अलावा, उसके लिए इतना मुफ़ीद कोई और काम नहीं होगा।
items.gu: આ કામ સિવાય, તેને આટલું અનુકૂળ બીજું કોઈ કામ નહીં હોય.
